trust_decision.summary: Fields read from per-user object config lines are decided to be data, not shell code or environment, by parsing them without eval (parse_object_kv_list_non_eval / source_conf) and refusing reserved keys such as PATH, LD_PRELOAD and BASH_FUNC_*; fs search path is decided to be inside the user's home by an anchored realpath prefix check. At the pinned commit all of this is already in place.

landing_point.why: The advisory names config-field injection reaching root; the search scripts that loaded user conf rows with eval are what the fix diff changes and where a reader of the summary would go first. At the pinned commit that line already calls the non-eval parser.
